notes.title: System Crash - Underworld DLC Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25537596/c90de411cc2a407e0e81e6f2f0b5cab6d9e851ab.jpg[/img]

Runners, it's time to return to San Angeles!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962540/System_Crash__Underworld/]System Crash - Underworld[/url] introduces an exciting new story campaign and a powerful new card set focused on turning your Archive (discard pile) into a potent resource. 

From Agents and Support cards that gain strength the more you discard, to Events that let you bring cards from your Archive back into play, Underworld adds a range of exciting new options to deck building.

The Underworld set is powered by a unique risk-reward dynamic. Underworld cards can generate huge burst damage, but you'll need to burn your own deck to fuel your combos. Played well, you can sweep your opposition off the board. Played poorly, you burn down your own deck and leave yourself weakened and exposed.


[h1]Features:[/h1]

- An exciting new story campaign designed to challenge experienced players.

- 30 New missions.

- 20 New cards to collect.

- New card mechanics that allow you to burn your own deck for power.

[i]Note - The DLC campaign, when installed, will be found under the "Choose Module" main menu option.[/i]

tags.feature: - An exciting new story campaign designed to challenge experienced players.

notes.title: Halloween Update - The Harlequins
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25537596/f1514b1c53db9d2af8a87aecf000d71a18adf44d.jpg[/img]

Halloween is here, runners, and a sinister new faction emerges on the mean streets of San Angeles - The Harlequins!

The Harlequins are a free update for anyone who owns System Crash, adding 3 new cards with a unique play dynamic.

Each Harlequin, individually, is not particularly dangerous. But as you put more Harlequins into play, their threat grows dramatically. With the clowns, the more the merrier!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25537596/cb6bb8fed910659e0eeedfa3de60602cdac3e18a.jpg[/img]

All Harlequins have the ability: 

"On play and when another Harlequin is played - deal 2 x the number of Harlequins you control in damage to a random enemy Agent."

So when you play a single Harlequin, it deals 2 damage to a random enemy Agent. Not particularly dramatic.

But as you play each new Harlequin, the newly-played Agent's ability will fire AND the other Harlequins will activate their ability again.

Play two Harlequins, and each will deal 4 damage to random enemies.

Play four Harlequins, and all four will deal 8 damage to random enemies, for a total of 32 points of damage! And that's before damage boosting effects!

With the right timing, this can decimate your opponent.

Harlequins can be won as mission rewards, or purchased for credits in the Black Market. 

(If you're playing from a pre-update save game, win a match in the Neon Arena, either practice or tournament, to unlock the Harlequins in the Black Market for purchase)

[b]Happy Halloween, Runners![b]

notes.title: Halloween Update - Night Terrors
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25537596/b13d245e6efc90a136442a5b2e0ce554379a79fa.png[/img]

Summon your courage and load your guns, Runners! Halloween is here, and with it comes...The Night Terrors!

The latest update to [b]System Crash[/b] introduces a challenging new mini-campaign, free for anyone who owns the game!

[list]
[*] Unlock the [b]Night Terrors[/b] story campaign by completing [b]Neon Noir[/b].
[*] 3 spooky new cards to add to your deck.
[*] 10 new missions to challenge veteran players.
[*] Halloween cards now have a chance to drop in the main campaign as mission rewards.
[/list]

[b]Happy Halloween, Runners![b]
